rabbi-shimon-berabbi.name: Rabbi Shimon, son of Rabbi
rabbi-shimon-berabbi.era: Tanna · Land of Israel, late 2nd–early 3rd century
rabbi-shimon-berabbi.bio: Son of Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi, who named him the ḥakham of the academy before his death (Ketubot 103b).
rabbi-shimon-berabbi.prompt: A learned young scholar in his 30s with a neat dark beard and the fine layered robes of the Nasi’s household, speaking respectfully before his father; background of the study hall in Sepphoris with limestone columns.
